Here are some of the cool cats that I subscribe to in my RSS reader. If you don't know what RSS is, it's basically a really cool way to curate your own feed of sites that you want to follow. I like this post from Kev Quirk about it, which also has mention of other blogrolls too. These are really cool ways to find new sites on the internet without going through search engine slop.
